changed.en: Distinct bronze embossed, silver faceted and charcoal-gold membership cards, using static metal textures and separate high-contrast member codes.
changed.zh-CN: 会员卡改为铜质压印、银色切面与炭黑金箔三档独立设计，采用静态金属纹理，会员码保持独立高对比展示。

changed.en: Compact member points and visit progress on phones, with inline navigation on tablets and desktops.
changed.zh-CN: 压缩手机会员积分与到店进度区域，平板和桌面导航移入页面内容上方。

changed.en: Head-office navigation drawer and two-column phone metrics; member tiers and visits remain visible in compact directories.
changed.zh-CN: 总部新增窄屏导航抽屉和手机双列指标，紧凑会员目录保留等级与到店次数。

fixed.en: Responsive wrapping for long names, store labels, balances and activity amounts across the three surfaces.
fixed.zh-CN: 修正三端长姓名、门店名称、余额及活动金额的响应式换行。

added.en: Bilingual, responsive member, staff and head-office surfaces with a neutral visual theme.
added.zh-CN: 采用中性主题的双语响应式会员、员工与总部界面。

added.en: Digital membership card, QR code, points and tier views, reward catalogue and activity details.
added.zh-CN: 数字会员卡、会员二维码、积分与等级视图、礼品目录和活动详情。

added.en: Store-scoped member views and head-office overview, member, store and staff directories.
added.zh-CN: 受门店范围限制的会员视图，以及总部概览、会员、门店和员工目录。

added.en: International phone input with Singapore +65 as the default, bilingual country search and E.164 validation.
added.zh-CN: 默认新加坡 +65 的国际号码输入、双语国家搜索与 E.164 校验。

added.en: SQLite schema migrations, aggregate projections, bounded reads, session storage and server-side access checks.
added.zh-CN: SQLite 结构迁移、汇总投影、限量查询、会话存储与服务端访问校验。

added.en: Standalone application packaging, local fonts, unit tests and isolated production-runtime integration checks.
added.zh-CN: 独立应用打包、本地字体、单元测试及隔离的生产构建集成检查。

added.en: DADE Membership repository baseline and bilingual product README.
added.zh-CN: DADE Membership 仓库基线与双语产品 README。

added.en: Version consistency validation and continuous integration workflow.
added.zh-CN: 版本一致性校验及持续集成流程。

added.en: Repository exclusions for local planning, credentials and runtime data.
added.zh-CN: 本地规划、凭据及运行数据的仓库排除配置。
